directive.quote: Cloud job: one Workshop tool brings in every AI conversation a person has, from every app, completely and resumably.

job: read the elements of a JSON array file a piece at a time, so a ChatGPT conversations.json too large to parse whole is kept one conversation at a time and resumed at a byte offset

distinct_from.why: The importer that calls this reader (readArchiveFile): it keeps each conversation through the records door and writes the cursor; this file only cuts a JSON array's elements out of a file.
